sources.title: Vizra Platform Architecture & Core Principles
sources.rawContent:
# Vizra Platform Architecture & Core Principles
Vizra is the dark-matter operating system for human curiosity.
- Obsidian Aesthetics: Strict black (#000000) canvas with surgical crimson accent (#eb3b2d).
- Zero AI Slop: No generic blue pills, fluid kinetic transitions at 60fps.
- Omnia AI: Native multimodal reasoning engine grounded in verified RAG and continuous learning.
- Knowledge Isolation: Strict tenant boundaries between global, workspace, and isolated project tiers.

sources.title: OMNIA 1.0 RAG & Verification Architecture Specification
sources.rawContent:
# OMNIA 1.0 RAG & Verification Architecture Specification
Lead AI Infrastructure Engineer Specification.
- Hybrid Retrieval: 60% Dense Cosine Similarity + 40% Sparse BM25 Lexical Matching.
- Zero Hallucination: Claims without verified citations are rejected or flagged.
- Grounding Gate: Continuous 6-stage provenance check ensuring URL authentications and excerpt alignment.

sources.title: Smart Medicine Dispenser Hardware Specifications
sources.rawContent:
# Smart Medicine Dispenser Hardware Specifications
- Optical IR drop sensor timeout: 1200ms drop window through chute before NEMA-17 motor reverse.
- Carousel: 14 partitioned pods with micro-servo lock.
- Conflicting report with Clinical Compliance protocol (800ms threshold).

conflictDetails.reason: Hardware spec requests 1200ms transit window; Clinical protocol specifies 800ms tamper limit.

concepts.simpleExplanation: Vizra uses pure black (#000000) backgrounds with targeted 4% surgical red (#eb3b2d) highlights instead of generic blue pills.
concepts.technicalExplanation: Design standard enforcing strict monochromatic dark-matter canvas (#000000), 60fps kinetic motion with cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), and zero generic AI slop.
concepts.practicalMeaning: Every user interface and state transition must feel sharp, tactile, and editorial rather than generic corporate SaaS.
concepts.example: Pulsing crimson indicators for online systems, high contrast typography with Instrument Serif.
whenNotToUse: Never introduce blue pill badges or round generic cards
commonMistakes: Overusing accent colors beyond 4% viewport ratio

concepts.simpleExplanation: Omnia retrieves knowledge using both keyword search (BM25) and conceptual semantic meaning (vectors) blended together.
concepts.technicalExplanation: 60% Dense Cosine Similarity (384d / Gemini embeddings) + 40% Sparse BM25 lexical token matching with Reciprocal Rank Fusion (k=60).
concepts.practicalMeaning: Ensures Omnia finds exact part numbers/IDs while understanding conceptual and conversational phrasing.
concepts.example: Searching "optical IR drop sensor timeout" retrieves exact 1200ms timing specs.
whenToUse: Every grounded question and factual retrieval task
whenNotToUse: Pure creative brain-storming with no factual requirement
commonMistakes: Relying solely on vector embeddings without lexical fallback for exact identifiers

concepts.simpleExplanation: The medicine dispenser checks if a pill fell through the chute within a specific time before reversing the motor.
concepts.technicalExplanation: Optical IR drop sensor window configured to detect pill occlusion during chute transit before triggering stepper retry sequence.
concepts.practicalMeaning: Hardware timing controls jam detection and prevents double-dispensing.
concepts.example: Pill drops past IR beam in 400ms -> motor proceeds to next slot.
whenToUse: Calibrating dispense cycles and jam recovery
whenNotToUse: When carousel shutter lock is open
commonMistakes: Ignoring clinical safety regulations regarding aperture exposure latency

logicRules.name: Hybrid Retrieval Weighting Rule
logicRules.condition: IF performing knowledge retrieval across Omnia Knowledge Base
logicRules.action: THEN compute combined score = 0.6 * denseScore + 0.4 * sparseBM25Score

logicRules.action: THEN cite verified source ID and excerpt; if ungrounded, state uncertainty
